o: Follow the aquatic adventures of a yellow sea sponge named SpongeBob who lives in a pineapple under the sea. When SpongeBob gets together with his friends in Bikini Bottom, there's always nautical nonsense to be found!

eps.o: When Patrick's Time Closet goes on the fritz, SpongeBob's history is re-written by time traveling interlopers.
SpongeBob falls asleep on the bus and ends up in a strange town full of Bikini Bottom doppelgangers.
Squidward loses his memories and adopts a new tough guy persona.
DoodleBob bites SpongeBob, transforming him into a "WereDoodle".
SpongeBob dresses up for Gorilla Suit Day and is mistaken for a real gorilla.
Mrs. Puff sends SpongeBob far away to a driving school in Klopnod.
Slappy brings his macabre sensibilities to the Krusty Krab when he's hired there as a server.
SpongeBob and Patrick have a spirited Halloween night at the Chum Bucket.
Gary's favorite ball falls into a monster-filled trench.
Squidward spends a day at the laundromat with his fellow Bikini Bottomites.
SpongeBob and Patrick must track down Old Man Jenkins' prized worm hog.
SpongeBob cleans up Bikini Bottom.
The Krusty Krew take on cafeteria duty at Pearl's school.
SpongeBob and Patrick must search for Squidward after the inside of his home turns into a vast garbage jungle.
In his latest secret formula scheme, Plankton disguises himself as a collectible figurine and winds up trapped in Bubble Bass' basement.
SpongeBob obtains a magician's wand and accidentally causes magical mayhem wherever he goes.
On Friday the 13th, Mr. Krabs' extreme superstitions become a disruption for everyone around him.
Pearl becomes a star player after joining her high school football team.
Sandy seeks Squidward's help to heal her sick tree, but his alternative gardening methods give her a headache.
SpongeBob and Squidward search for the perfect birthday present for Mr. Krabs.
The Gal Pals become unstoppable after Sandy teaches them karate. Before long, the entire town has gotten in on the action.
Plankton infiltrates a party thrown by Karen for her computer friends, but Karen quickly uncovers his ruse.
